faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty positions at CUTN?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 26th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Generally, a Master's degree with a minimum of 55% marks in the relevant field, along with NET/Ph.D or an equivalent qualification, is required. Specific qualifications may vary for different posts.

faq.question: Q3. How will the candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selection process details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for comprehensive information on the selection procedure.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions at CUTN?
faq.answer: The salary varies based on the specific post. For Sl. No. 1, it's Rs. 1,000 per teaching hour (max Rs. 50,000/month). For other posts, it's Rs. 500 per teaching hour (max Rs. 25,000/month), with one post having a maximum of Rs. 15,000/month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age limit for applying to these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Yes, there is a maximum age limit of 70 years specifically for superannuated teachers applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for the Guest Faculty recruitment at CUTN?
faq.answer: The application mode is through email. Interested candidates need to send their scanned application and relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions announced by the Central University of Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: These Guest Faculty positions are on a temporary basis, intended for the academic year 2026-27.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Central University of Tamil Nadu located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Tamil Nadu is located in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 610005.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Guest Faculty recruitment at CUTN is CUTN/CC/GF/08/2026.
